lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: O-oh! That happened to me too, when I first came out of the water.

lines: A heads up would've been nice.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Why'd you jump out of the water??

lines: I- Whatever. I was in the moment.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: It's okay, I get it. When Penni does it, it looks really fun.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: HAHA! You wanted to keep hanging out with me.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: It's okay if you're scared... I was too!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Oh, okay, Mr. Not Scared. Well, you could stay in the townhouse.

lines: Hmph. Fine. Just until we figure this out.
